meta.promptText: Which vitamin C serum should I buy for dark spots and dull skin in India?

response.text:
To tackle dark spots and dull skin, choosing a stable Vitamin C serum with supportive brightening ingredients like Niacinamide or Ferulic Acid works best.

The Minimalist 10% Vitamin C Face Serum uses stable **Ethyl Ascorbic Acid** to gently fade dark spots. It is lightweight and **beginner-friendly**.[smytten.com](https://smytten.com/blogs/skincare/11-best-vitamin-c-serums-for-brighter-glowing-skin#:~:text=The%20lightweight%20serum%20texture%20makes%20it%20suitable,Serum%20With%205%25%20Niacinamide%20%26%20Hyaluronic%20Acid.)

The Garnier Vitamin C + Face Serum combines **Vitamin C with Niacinamide and Salicylic Acid** to instantly revive dullness and clear uneven skin tone.

The Pilgrim 10% Vitamin C Face Serum features **Kakadu Plum and 5% Niacinamide** to target pigmentation and boost long-lasting radiance.

The Deconstruct Vitamin C Serum pairs **10% Vitamin C with 0.5% Ferulic Acid** to enhance antioxidant protection and combat sun-induced dark spots.

The Plum 15% Vitamin C Face Serum delivers a higher potency **15% concentration** with mandarin extracts for stubborn pigmentation and tired skin.

The Foxtale Vitamin C Brightening Face Serum blends **pure L-Ascorbic Acid and Vitamin E** to rapidly restore luminosity and protect against environmental stress.
